fossil_elements: A complete, fully articulated Tyrannosaurus Rex skeleton standing majestically, polished to a museum-quality finish.
Soft, ambient spotlighting highlighting the skeletal structure.
A clean, minimalist museum base for the skeleton.
Subtle informational display plaque in the background.
A small crowd of animated, awe-struck onlookers (children and adults) viewing the display.
environment_details.style_notes: rounded, tactile; clean, educational aesthetic. Focus on detailed, accurate skeletal articulation with a stylized, inviting museum environment.

visual_logic.composition: A medium-wide shot of a grand museum hall. The fully articulated T-Rex skeleton stands as the central focal point, viewed from a slightly low angle to emphasize its impressive size. The background shows a modern museum interior. Centered at the top is the text 'Dino Fossil Hunt!' in bold, gleaming gold, 3D block letters with a celebratory sparkle effect, slightly raised above the exhibit base.  Centered at the bottom is additional text 'Player Wins!'
visual_logic.ground: Polished museum floor reflecting the ambient light.
visual_logic.lighting: Bright, clean studio lighting with focused spotlights on the skeleton to emphasize its victory. A warm, celebratory glow for the 'Player Wins!' text.
